gates.action: Decide whether an unclaimed automatic credit order created before Pause must revalidate current demand before provider submission
gates.target: campaign_credit_order / campaign_credit_claim existing pending automatic orders
gates.reason: Actual SQL reproduction: available500, threshold0, only campaign completed with stickyPause; previously created pending order remains claimable. Changing pending/payment behavior was explicitly held for parent decision; no monetary policy changed silently.
gates.recommended: Under existing wallet lock, revalidate present demand only for unclaimed pending automatic orders; retain order/idempotency key; never blindly cancel processing/unknown-outcome or paid settlement. Keep separately consented global low-balance top-up behavior.
gates.alternative: Retain preexisting pending-order consent and explicitly describe it as an exception to Campaign Pause. Do not claim Pause blocks all wallet purchases.
